market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Bond yields near 20-year highs create equity headwinds. Oil above $103 sustains inflation fears. Trump-Xi talks offer de-escalation but trade truce only 2 months. Yen/dollar realignment adds FX noise. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy, defense, and short-duration bonds.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI application layer (agent-commerce, sovereignty) creates new revenue models. Defense spending cycle multi-year. Biotech capital markets reopening. However, persistent high yields and inflation cap multiple expansion. Structural shift in bond markets means lower real returns on fixed income long-term.
